$comment: Text pool for the Safety Alert type. Every note is an alert. Alerts are calm and practical: who may pick up a child, a serious allergy or medical need, or a serving restriction, and where to find details. They never say why a court or the church made a restriction. See README.md for the format, tokens, and writing rules.

openers: {name} may not serve in kids or student ministry. Questions go to the kids ministry director.
{name} has a severe peanut allergy and carries an epinephrine pen. Keep peanuts out of any meal {he} attends.
{name} may serve only with another approved adult present. See the serving coordinator for details.
Do not schedule {name} for any role with access to the kids wing. Contact the office with questions.
{name} has a seizure condition. If {he} has a seizure, call 911 and send for the first-aid team.
{name} is not to be given keys or building access. Refer questions to the operations director.
{name} is diabetic and may need juice or a snack quickly. The first-aid kit at the welcome desk has both.
Severe bee sting allergy for {name}. {He} carries an epinephrine pen in {his} bag.
{name} may attend services but may not serve on any team. Contact a pastor with questions.
{name} has a pacemaker. Keep {him} away from the handheld security wand at large events.
{name} may not ride on church transportation without staff approval. Questions go to the office.
Review in progress. {name} may not serve with minors until a pastor clears {him}.
{name} has a severe latex allergy. Use non-latex gloves at first-aid and kitchen events.
{name} may visit the kids wing only to drop off and pick up. The kids ministry director has details.
{name} uses oxygen. Keep the side aisle clear near {his} seat and know where the first-aid team is.

Handle this quietly and kindly, as with anyone.

openers: Only {name}'s mom or dad may pick {him} up. Ask for the pickup tag every time.
{name} has a severe peanut allergy. No peanut snacks in {his} room. An epinephrine pen is in {his} bag.
{name} may not be released to anyone who is not on the authorized pickup list. See the legal note on {his} record.
{name} is allergic to tree nuts. Check every snack label before serving the room.
{name} has asthma and uses an inhaler, which is in {his} bag. Call a parent if {he} has trouble breathing.
{name} has a severe egg allergy. Snacks for {his} room must be egg free.
Do not release {name} to a grandparent unless a parent calls ahead. Details are with the kids ministry director.
{name} has type 1 diabetes. A parent checks in with the room leader at drop-off each week.
{name} has a dairy allergy that can be serious. Offer only the dairy-free snack box.
Pickup for {name} is limited to the adults on the authorized list. Call the director if anyone else comes.
{name} has epilepsy. If {he} has a seizure, time it, keep {him} safe, and send for the first-aid team.
{name} has a severe bee sting allergy. Keep {him} indoors during outdoor activities if bees are around.
{name} is allergic to latex. Use non-latex gloves and keep balloons out of {his} room.
{name} may be picked up only by the parent who checked {him} in. Match the tag.
{name} has a shellfish allergy. Watch for it at events with catered meals.
{name} may try to leave the room. Keep the half door closed and count heads at transitions.
{name} has a heart condition. No running games, and a parent stays on campus during services.
{name} gets very sick from gluten. Use the gluten-free snacks only.
{name} has a feeding tube. A parent handles all feeding, so do not give {him} food or drink.
Court order on file for {name}. Release {him} only to the adults listed and call the director with any question.
{name} has a severe sesame allergy. Read the labels on crackers and bread.
{name} wears a medical alert bracelet. Read it before giving any first aid.
{name} cannot have red food dye. Skip colored candy and drinks in {his} room.
{name} carries an epinephrine pen in {his} backpack. Leaders should know where it is every week.
{name} may not be photographed or posted online. Keep {him} out of all event photos.
{name} has a severe kiwi and banana allergy. Check fruit snacks before serving them.
At student events, only the parent named on {name}'s pickup list may sign {him} out.
{name} is hard of hearing and may not hear a fire alarm. A leader stays with {him} during drills.
{name} has a strawberry allergy. Watch for it in yogurt and fruit cups.
No medicine of any kind for {name}, not even sunscreen. The parents handle it all.
